title: SnO / SnO2 QSCI-error version sensitivity — provenance for the stated observed range
why: The QSCI-vs-FCI(CASCI) error on the Sn-oxide active spaces drifts across PySCF versions / runs (RHF/ECP numerics shift the 3rd decimal). This records the actual observations behind the 'observed range' quoted in the paper/README/ledger, so the range is traceable rather than asserted. The robust claim is the <=0.6 mHa assertion enforced by reproduce.py; the exact value is version-sensitive.
note: All observations are within chemical accuracy (<=1.6 mHa) and within the reproduce.py <=0.6 assertion. The earlier '0.45 / 0.18' endpoints were not reproducible in any environment on hand and have been dropped in favor of the observed, traceable span.
